name: Dell UltraSharp 27" Monitor
description: Professional-grade 4K UHD monitor with USB-C connectivity. Features IPS panel with 99% sRGB coverage, perfect for designers and content creators. Includes adjustable stand with height, tilt, and pivot options.

name: Logitech MX Master 3S
description: Ergonomic wireless mouse with 8000 DPI sensor. Features MagSpeed electromagnetic scroll wheel, quiet clicks, and works on any surface including glass. USB-C quick charging.

name: Apple Magic Keyboard
description: Wireless keyboard with Touch ID for secure authentication. Features scissor mechanism keys with 1mm travel for responsive typing. Rechargeable via Lightning cable.

name: Samsung 34" Curved Gaming Monitor
description: Ultra-wide curved display with 165Hz refresh rate and 1ms response time. AMD FreeSync Premium support for tear-free gaming. HDR10 support with 1000R curvature.

name: Keychron K2 Mechanical Keyboard
description: Compact 75% wireless mechanical keyboard with Gateron switches. RGB backlight with multiple effects. Works with Mac and Windows. Hot-swappable switch sockets.

name: LG 32" 4K Monitor
description: Large 32-inch 4K display with HDR10 support. AMD FreeSync for smooth visuals. Built-in speakers and USB-C with 60W power delivery for laptop charging.

name: Razer DeathAdder V3
description: Ultra-lightweight ergonomic gaming mouse at just 59g. Features 30K DPI optical sensor. Optical mouse switches with 90 million click durability.

name: Bose QuietComfort Headphones
description: Premium noise-cancelling wireless headphones with legendary Bose sound. Up to 24 hours battery life. Adjustable EQ in Bose Music app. Comfortable over-ear design.
